status.hinweis: Preview with made-up data – saved on this device only
einstellungen.hinweis: This preview shows made-up tasks only. Your changes are saved on this device.
start.fehler.falscher_schluessel: The database cannot be opened with the stored key. Nothing was deleted. Please contact the person who looks after Daedyx Tasks for you. Earlier backups are in the “backups” folder next to the database.
start.fehler.zu_neu: This database belongs to a newer version of Daedyx Tasks. Please install the latest version. Your data was not changed. Earlier backups are in the “backups” folder next to the database.
start.fehler.kein_platz: There is not enough space on the drive for the backup before updating (needed: {noetig} MB, free: {frei} MB). Nothing was changed, your data is intact. Please free up space and start Daedyx Tasks again.
start.fehler.sicherung: No backup could be created before updating your data. Therefore nothing was changed, your data is intact. Please free up space on the drive, check that the data folder is writable, and start Daedyx Tasks again. Earlier backups are in the “backups” folder next to the database.
start.fehler.anderes: The database could not be opened or updated. Your data was not deleted. Please start Daedyx Tasks again; if that does not help, contact the person who looks after Daedyx Tasks for you. Earlier backups are in the “backups” folder next to the database.
einstellungen.dunkel.hinweis: Applies when the design is dark. The sliders are limited so that text stays easy to read.

einstellungen.lizenzen.bausteine: The list of all components used, with their licences, comes with the installer.
hintergrund.autostart.gesperrt: Disabled in Task Manager. Turn it back on there under “Startup apps”.
hintergrund.weiterlaufen: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed
hintergrund.weiterlaufen.aus: Off: no reminders arrive after closing.
hintergrund.weiterlaufen.hinweis: On: reminders arrive even without an open window, closing only hides it.
hintergrund.titel_zeigen.hinweis: The title then appears in the notification centre and on the lock screen, where others can see it too.
hintergrund.test.text: This is what a reminder looks like. The content is made up.
hintergrund.test.ok: Sent. It appears at the bottom right and in the notification centre.
